debug_name: Chapel interior + descent staircase to Limbo
_comment: Vertical-stack region 2 of 3: the chapel building's interior floor + the entire descent staircase down to Limbo. Owns chapel_interior.glb (interior floor + upper-flight steps + continuous descent + corridor walls/ceiling). No terrain (chapel floor + descent corridor are static mesh). Triggers fire on both seams: north back to surface (exiting the chapel door), south down to limbo (stepping off the last descent step).

triggers._comment: Player walks back out the chapel door. Same trigger volume as surface's chapel_door_enter (mirrored across door threshold). Instant + preserve_player_pos -- continuous world, no teleport.

Player steps off the last continuous-descent step onto Limbo's floor. Trigger sits at the bottom-of-stairs landing (world Z ~= -346.85, Y ~= -43.13). Corridor cross-section is 4.8m wide (Â±2.4m X). Instant + preserve_player_pos.

Forced-engage trigger for the Signing. Sits between the Guide (X=-1.888, Z=-208.315) and the descent staircase entrance (Z ~= -213). If the player walks past the Guide toward the stairs without talking to him, this fires force_engage:guide which begins a Scene + dispatches the Guide on a scripted-walk to intercept the player + opens the dialog. Player gets the Signing offered either way -- by approach (E-talk on the Guide) or by walking past (this trigger). Suppressed once signing_committed is set (the trigger has no flags_required gate today because the rescue handler also no-ops once committed; if the flag-gate becomes general infra in the future, this trigger gets flags_forbidden:[signing_committed]).

actor_spawns._comment: The Guide waits inside the chapel at the left side of the entryway. Position from F3 probe (-1.888, 22.301, -208.315). Default yaw = -pi/2 (~-1.5708) = facing west. The previous comment claimed +pi/2 was west based on derivation from yawFacing(), but in-game testing showed +pi/2 renders as east -- meaning the actor's model-space forward is rotated opposite of how I read it. Empirical value wins; corrected to -pi/2. Westward feels right cosmologically -- the player approaches from south through the door and descent is north, neither direction his focus; he stands transverse, contemplative. Lifecycle: until lupa_felled the Guide is silent (talk_requires_flag) + chapel door is Locked. Lupa-fall fires the rescue scripted event: (1) chapel door unlocks (audible lock-click), (2) Guide becomes talkable, (3) Guide stays in this spot until Signing commits. The yaw-acknowledgment overlay turns him up to ~35 degrees off this spawn yaw when the player is within 6m. Player either walks up to the Guide (E to talk) or tries to bypass him toward the stairs (forced-engage trigger fires). After Signing commits, the Guide does the post-Signing walk to the outside plateau (post_flag_positions[signing_committed]) and on subsequent save/load respawns there.

_territory_note: Territory volumes declare chapel_interior's law-domain. AI chase-gate, audio/lighting region lookup, and future systems all derive which region claims this position from this geometry. (1) Chapel building interior. (2) Descent corridor as a single tilted OBB hugging the actual ramp surface (rotation_euler_deg around X axis matches the ramp slope so no false-foreign airspace wedges).

territory._comment: Chapel building interior. Floor at Y=22, ceiling above. XZ matches chapel_footprint center=(0,-212.67) half=(3,4) plus a small margin for the door threshold and stained-glass apse.

Descent corridor + staircase as a single tilted OBB. Center is shifted perpendicular-up from the ramp surface midpoint by half_Y so the OBBs BOTTOM face exactly tracks the ramp surface (south-bottom corner lands at world (0,-43.31,-353.15), north-bottom at (0,20.71,-213.15)). half_Y=2.5m gives 5m of headroom above the ramp. half_X=2.4m matches corridor inner walls. half_Z=76.97m is half the 153.94m ramp diagonal length. Rotation -24.55 deg around X matches slope = atan(64.01 / 140) = 24.55 deg. Zero airspace wedges; zero below-floor void claimed.
